claims.claim: Q2 revenue of $268.5M exceeded the prior Q2 guidance range of $263M-$266M; Tenable then raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $1.075B-$1.081B from the prior $1.068B-$1.078B range.
Q2 non-GAAP operating margin reached 24.7%, up 540 basis points year over year, creating a concrete profitability benchmark for subsequent quarters.

risks: non-GAAP margin excludes costs that must be reconciled to GAAP
share repurchases can improve per-share optics without proving durable organic growth
contradictions: Execution beat guidance and margins expanded, but growth remains below the pace implied by some AI-security narratives; future evidence should separate category excitement from realized revenue.
unknowns: Q3 conversion of new enterprise platform customers into durable recurring expansion
organic contribution of AI Exposure and Hexa to bookings

recommendation.reason: Beat-and-raise evidence gives explicit expectations and falsifiers for underwriting.
